annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires that any incoming segment whose ACK value falls outside the specified range be discarded and that an ACK segment be sent back. The phrase “whose ACK value” implies the segment has an ACK flag, so segments without an ACK flag are not subject to this rule. The clause does not leave room for materially different implementation behaviours, nor does it omit a concrete constraint that would change the operational interpretation.
